If you made it here, congrats! Thank you for playing GT - Other Worlds, at least in its unfinished state. This pack has been a passion project of mine for several years and I've gone through a lot while working on it in the background, it took a lot of things at once for all the dominoes to fall into place for this alpha being released. And I'm glad if you see this! Hope you stick around for more GTOW in the future!
A short and non-complete list of thanks to give:
§d§fThank you to §dNyagi_Byte§f, one of the original contributers on the pack and someone who got me into gregtech on her own rights. She is also a fellow modpack dev!
Thank you to §dLgmrszd §fwho not only supported me making this pack, but also made the Harvestcraft ZS file, thank you so much!
Thank you to §dAce_Muffins §fwho contributed some textures.
Thank you to §dWaitingIdly §fwho helped with some multiblock development and gave permission to use the Divine Journey 2 petal textures
Thank you to §dIncandescenseSy §ffor help with some other multiblock parts.
And, of course, thank you, for playing up to this point, let's hope the pack only gets better!
